mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (chat_room_id, sender_id, content, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{isRead}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT cm.* FROM chat_message cm JOIN chat_room cr ON cm.chat_room_id = cr.id JOIN chat_request cq ON cr.chat_request_id = cq.chat_request_id WHERE cm.chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} AND ( (cq.requester_id = #{userId} AND (cr.left_at_a IS NULL OR cm.created_at > cr.left_at_a)) OR (cq.responder_id = #{userId} AND (cr.left_at_b IS NULL OR cm.created_at > cr.left_at_b)) ) ORDER BY cm.created_at ASC
